intended_behavior: In the Mem0Storage constructor, when the mem0_local_config dictionary exists and is non-empty, the code should initialize self.memory by calling Memory.from_config(mem0_local_config) instead of Memory.from_config(config). This ensures that the local mem0-specific configuration is correctly applied during memory initialization. The rest of the behavior remains unchanged: if the mem0_api_key is present, initialize MemoryClient with the API key; if no key and no local config, initialize a default Memory instance. This preserves existing functionality and resolves the bug where local mem0 configs are ignored, leading to failures like missing API keys.
